entries.question: How do I register my UPPAbaby product?
entries.answer: Register on the [product registration page](/pages/product-registration). It takes about two minutes. Registering does not change your warranty: your pram has three years whether you register or not. What it does is hold your receipt on file, so a later claim does not wait on it, and it lets us contact you if there is ever a safety notice. Have your receipt and the serial number ready, and use one form per product. On a pram the serial number is on a white label under the frame, near the rear axle. Registration is for the original purchaser only.

entries.question: What safety standards do UPPAbaby prams meet?
entries.answer: Every UPPAbaby pram sold in Australia complies with the mandatory Australian standard, AS/NZS 2088:2000, and is also tested to the current edition, AS 2088:2022 including Amendment 1:2024. UPPAbaby prams are endorsed by INPAA, the Infant & Nursery Product Alliance Australia. Fabrics and leathers are tested free of lead, DEHP, azo dyes, formaldehyde and PFAS. The Mesa sold here is approved to AS/NZS 1754 as a Type A2 rearward-facing infant restraint. A capsule bought overseas cannot legally be used in an Australian car. More on the [safety page](/pages/safety).

entries.question: How do I look after my UPPAbaby pram?
entries.answer: Rinse grit out of the wheels and brake, store the pram dry and out of the sun, and give it a quick check once a season. After a beach or gravel path, hose the wheels, brush grit from the brake bar and let it dry. Rinse off salt water straight away, as salt corrodes the frame. Never fold or store it damp. Once a season, test the brake, the fold click, each harness strap, the wheels, the frame screws, the bumper bar release and the recline. Do not use oil or lubricant spray. A squeak that survives a rinse is a job for a free Tune-Up Day. Parts are on the [spare parts page](/pages/spare-parts).
entries.decided_reason: Help centre article checked against uppababy.com.au on 1 Oct 2026

entries.question: How do I clean my UPPAbaby pram?
entries.answer: Spot clean or hand wash the fabrics in cold water with a mild detergent, and dry them flat in the shade. Do not machine wash them, and no bleach, fabric softener, ironing, dry cleaning or tumble drying. Let the fabric dry fully before it goes back on. The harness is wipe only, with a damp cloth and mild soap: it is a safety part and washing weakens it. Wipe the frame with warm water and mild soap, no scourers. Wipe leather with a damp cloth only, no conditioner. Treat sunscreen the same day with a damp cloth and a little dish soap. Rinse grit from the wheels, and never oil them.

entries.question: How long is the UPPAbaby warranty, and what does it cover?
entries.answer: Prams and strollers have a three year warranty against manufacturing defects from the date of purchase, whether you register or not. Bassinets, the RumbleSeat, PiggyBack and Changing Station also have three years, most other accessories two, and the Mesa capsule has a lifetime warranty for the original purchaser. Proof of purchase from an authorised retailer is needed for every claim. The warranty is not transferable and is valid only in the country of purchase. It does not cover wear and tear, misuse, airline damage or accidents. A Mesa capsule or base in a car accident goes through the [Crash Exchange Program](/pages/crash-exchange-program), which never covers prams. Full terms are on the [warranty page](/pages/warranty).

entries.question: Can I fold my Vista with the seat on?
entries.answer: Yes. The Vista V3 folds with the toddler seat attached, as long as the seat faces forward, away from you, reclined to the second most upright position with the canopy closed. If the seat faces you, turn it round first. Take off the bassinet, a RumbleSeat or a Mesa capsule before you fold. A PiggyBack board can stay on, folded up. In the UPPAbaby range, only the Kona folds with its seat facing either way. On a Vista V2 or earlier, fold with the seat facing forward too, with the handlebar raised and the front wheel locks off.

entries.question: What are the age and weight limits on the Vista V3?
entries.answer: The bassinet, which is in the box, is from birth to 9 kg, or until your baby can push up on hands and knees. The toddler seat is from 6 months to 22.7 kg, so before 6 months use the bassinet or the Mesa capsule. The RumbleSeat V3 is from 6 months to 15.9 kg. The Mesa is from birth (2.0 kg) to 15 kg and clicks straight onto the frame. The PiggyBack board takes a standing child from about two years, up to 25 kg, and the basket holds 13.6 kg. The bassinet is for naps on the go, not overnight sleep.

entries.question: How do I fold my Vista V3?
entries.answer: Take off the bassinet, a RumbleSeat or a Mesa first. Then: 1. Put the brake on, check the front wheel locks are off and keep the basket light. 2. Raise the handlebar to its highest position. 3. Turn the toddler seat to face forward, recline it to the second most upright position and close the canopy. 4. Squeeze both fold triggers under the handlebar. 5. Push the handlebar forward and down until the auto-lock clicks. It stands on its own when folded. To unfold, release the auto-lock latch and lift the handlebar until it clicks open. If the fold sticks, it is usually the seat position.

entries.question: How do I fly with my Vista or Cruz?

entries.question: How do I adjust the harness on an older Vista?

entries.question: How do I use the Vista PiggyBack board?

entries.question: How do I look after the leather on my pram?

Over time the real leather will age and develop a patina. Damage from sun, sweat, detergents or damp storage is not covered by the warranty, and a worn bumper bar cover is available as a [spare part](/pages/spare-parts).

entries.question: How does the TravelSafe Program work?
entries.answer: Buy an UPPAbaby travel bag and register the bag and your gear before you fly. Airline damage is then covered for four years from the purchase of your gear, at no cost beyond the bag. A bag registered after the flight is not covered. If something is damaged, lodge a request marked TravelSafe within 14 days with proof of travel, photographs, both serial numbers and your receipts. It is not travel insurance and does not cover loss or theft. Details are on the [TravelSafe Program](/pages/travelsafe-program) page.

entries.question: How do I keep my pram serviced, and what are Tune-Up Days?
entries.answer: Give your pram a ten-minute check once a season, and bring it to a free Tune-Up Day. Anyone with an UPPAbaby pram can come, and the team checks, cleans and adjusts the brakes, wheels, harness, fold and canopy in about fifteen minutes. Spots are limited, so book ahead. Lifetime Service Support is a separate service with its own conditions: complimentary maintenance checks for up to ten years from the original purchase date, for prams bought from an authorised Australian retailer. Replacement parts and major repairs are not included. Between visits, rinse grit from the wheels and brake, and never oil the pram. If anything does not lock, or the frame is cracked or bent, stop using it and lodge a request through our [support page](/pages/support).

entries.question: What is the Minu V3?
entries.answer: The Minu V3 is UPPAbaby's compact stroller. It weighs 7.6 kg, folds one-handed to 25 x 45 x 55 cm, about carry-on size, and stands on its own. It suits one child from birth to 22.7 kg, ready from birth with the included infant insert. The seat faces forward only. It has front and independent rear suspension and a 9.1 kg basket. The Mesa fits with the Minu V3 Mesa adapter, and no other brand of capsule fits the Minu V3. The Minu travel bag is covered by [TravelSafe](/pages/travelsafe-program) once registered, and has a hidden pocket for a tracking device.

entries.question: Can I take the Minu V3 on board the plane?

Some airlines cap carry-on at 7 kg, which the Minu V3 is over, and some count the pram as your one bag. If it goes in the hold, use the Minu travel bag and register it under the [TravelSafe Program](/pages/travelsafe-program) before you fly, as airline damage is otherwise excluded from the warranty. The bag has a hidden pocket for a tracking device.

entries.question: How do I fold my Minu?
entries.answer: The Minu V3 folds and unfolds with one hand, in one motion. Put the brake on. If a capsule is fitted, take it off and fold the capsule adapters down, as they can stay on. Slide and squeeze the grey button on the handlebar at the same time, then check the safety latch on the side of the frame has caught. The bumper bar and snack tray can stay on: press the button on each side and move them up first. To unfold, release the safety latch. It stands on its own when folded and has a carry strap. The steps are the same on the original Minu and Minu V2.

entries.question: Can I use the Minu V3 for my newborn?
entries.answer: Yes. The Minu V3 is suitable from birth as sold. The infant insert is included, and the seat has a from-birth recline. The bassinet does not fit the Minu V3, and it does not need one. The Mesa capsule fits with the Minu V3 Mesa adapter, and no other brand of capsule fits the Minu V3. The Minu Duo is also suitable from birth, on both seats.

entries.question: Which car capsules fit my UPPAbaby pram?
entries.answer: The Mesa clicks straight onto the Vista V3, Cruz V3 and Kona with no adapter. It fits the Minu V3 with the Minu V3 Mesa adapter, the Minu Duo with the Minu Duo Mesa adapters (one capsule, on the parent's left), and the Ridge V2 with the Ridge Mesa/Bassinet adapters. In the current range, the Vista V3, Cruz V3, Ridge V2 and Kona take another brand's capsule, and only these: Maxi-Cosi Mico AP / Mico Plus, Maxi-Cosi Citi, Maxi-Cosi Mico 12 and Mico 12LX (made after 20 April 2022), Nuna PIPA, Nuna KLIK Plus and Joie i-Gemm, with the matching UPPAbaby adapter. The Minu V3 and Minu Duo take only the Mesa. CYBEX is not supported.

entries.question: Can I use a non-UPPAbaby adapter to fit a car capsule to my pram?
entries.answer: No. Only car capsule adapters made and tested by UPPAbaby are approved for UPPAbaby prams. Another maker's adapter may damage your pram and, in serious cases, injure your child, and third-party modifications void the warranty. The Mesa needs no adapter on the Vista V3, Cruz V3 or Kona, and uses the matching UPPAbaby adapter on the Minu V3, Minu Duo and Ridge V2. A short list of Maxi-Cosi, Nuna and Joie capsules fit the Vista V3, Cruz V3, Ridge V2 and Kona with the matching UPPAbaby adapter. The Minu V3 and Minu Duo take only the Mesa, the older Minu V2 takes select capsules with the Minu V2 Car Seat Adapter, and CYBEX capsules are not supported on any UPPAbaby frame.
